# A Date in Dhaka

> An interactive romantic pixel-art adventure set across the heritage lanes and nostalgic memories of Dhaka.

## Documentation & Features
- [Date Itinerary Planner](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-place): 12 curated Dhaka places, foods, and adventures with paginated browsing.
- [Retro Mini-Games Suite](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-game): High-performance canvas & Phaser arcade games including Run to Totoro, Fuchka Chase, and Run to the Bus Stop.
- [DU Postcard](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-letter): Vintage aerogramme postbox with Web Audio chiptune synthesis and IndexedDB persistence.
- [Vinyl Soundtrack Player](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-final): Curated romantic tracks with dynamic 6-song preference matching and full 11-track vault pagination.
- [Totoro Locator Radar](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-map): Retro Dhaka GPS radar tracker and review ledger.
- [Celestial Star Atlas](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-telescope): Astrolabe telescope lens and star discovery catalog.
- [Totoro Vitals Monitor](https://totorosaysplease.vercel.app/#screen-vitals): Bio-telemetry lead-II ECG cardiac rhythm monitor.
